# Hannah Pixels

> Hannah Pixels is an international print and packaging house creating considered physical brand experiences, luxury packaging, and bespoke print for brands worldwide.

## Overview
- Website: https://hannahpixels.com
- Inquiries: info@hannahpixels.com | +91 70390 38842
- Parent Group: BRAHM Global Holdings (London, UK)
- Reach: Worldwide Delivery & Client Partnerships

## Core Capabilities
- **Luxury Packaging**: Custom rigid boxes, magnetic closure boxes, neck-and-shoulder boxes, luxury presentation packaging.
- **Product Packaging**: Custom cartons, folding boxboard, tailored retail packaging.
- **Fragrance & Beauty**: Perfume cartons, cosmetic packaging, velvet & EVA foam inserts, embossed secondary packaging.
- **Chocolate & Confectionery**: Food-grade boards, multi-tier chocolate boxes, bespoke sleeves.
- **Paper & Carry**: Luxury paper shopping bags, custom grosgrain and cotton ribbon handles, specialty kraft and coated papers.
- **Books & Publishing**: Hardcover editions, coffee table books, lookbooks, layflat binding, custom slipcases.

## Materials & Finishes
- Foil Stamping (Gold, Copper, Silver, Holographic, Tinted foils)
- Blind & Multi-level Embossing / Debossing
- Specialty Uncoated & Textured Papers
- Precision Screen Printing & UV Varnishing
- Custom Die-cutting & Structural Engineering

## Process Sequence
1. Discover: Understanding brand identity, product dimensions, and functional requirements.
2. Develop: Dielines, structural prototyping, material sampling.
3. Refine: Exploring board weights, textures, colors, and specialist finishes.
4. Produce: High-precision offset and specialty print runs.
5. Finish: Detailed finishing passes (emboss, foil, laminate, assembly).
6. Deliver: Global logistics and doorstep delivery worldwide.
